Hinterlands of Blind Midshotgatepool

Original: https://shrouded-lands.fandom.com/wiki/Hinterlands_of_Blind_Midshotgatepool

Connects to: 20.10, 23.16

Includes hexes: 25.18, 25.19, 26.19, 26.20, 27.18, 27.19 and 28.21.

The hinterlands of Blind Midshotgatepool are few and cramped, lying as they do between the mountains, the sea and the desert.

Hex summary:

  • 25.18 (The Glutinous Mudplain): the mud’s corpse fusing properties are of great interest to necromancers.
  • 25.19 (The Pit of the Waker Worms): they remain sleeping as long as they are buried under running water.
  • 26.19 (Yrump Marsh): if the bullywogs were to be evicted lucrative spices could be harvested here.
  • 26.20 (The August City of Blind Midshotgatepool): a town riven by division and mad bureaucracy.
  • 27.18 (The Fanged Cliffs): the mating dance of flying snakes is quite a sight to see to keep your distance.
  • 27.19 (The Drowned Temple): due to ancient compact the pews must always be full, which it now lying completely under water makes somewhat difficult.
  • 28.21 (The Angler): a unique and hungry mermaid.

Connection:

  • During the war with the City of Shuttered Windows, the Witch Queen prevented the knights of Thring from coming to Blind Midshotgatepool’s aid (23.16).
  • Jota, Zigmund and Hansa Koldransons are local heroes (20.10).
